messages:
jamie: Heads-up: routing-service v2 will go live at 14:30 PT / 21:30 UTC. plan: 10% canary for 15m -> 50% -> full. can someone run the post-deploy miniscan and call out any quick fixes? :eyes:

alex: I'm available. I’ll kick off the canary at 21:30 UTC and run the checklist below. ping me if you want to watch metrics: p99 latency / error-rate / model checksum / cache hit-rate.

morgan: sample smoke checks i'll run: 1) health endpoint 2) small generation 3) token-cost sanity 4) kv-cache warmup. sample curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16,"model":"routing-service-v2"}'
```

alex: checklist I'm using (short):
- GET /health -> 200
- curl gen -> coherent 1-2 token response
- grafana: check p99 < 1200ms, errors < 0.5%
- infra: pod restarts == 0
- model sha matches release tag
- cache hit-rate >= 60% within 5m

deploy-bot: Deployment event: routing-service v2 canary started by alex at 2050078985 (10% traffic). :rocket:

sam: Rollback note: if we see >1% errors or p99 > 2s for 5m, run `/deploy rollback routing-service --to-tag v1.4.2 --reason "canary regress"` (requires ops role). I’ll be on-call for rollback if needed.

lee: I can watch metrics for the first 30m and handle pager if something spikes. :thumbsup:

alex: quick status: first 5m smoke: health OK, curl gen ok, p99 ~ 680ms, errors 0.12%. cache warming at 48% after a few requests. model sha matches.

alex: 10m in saw a single 502 from pod routing-canary-3, logs show OOM kill in liveness check: `kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (python)`

alex: mitigation: restarted pod, bumped container memory from 3Gi -> 4Gi for canary via quick patch, pod rejoined. re-run smoke curl -> OK. leaving canary at 10% to bake another 10m.

morgan: good catch. please note the config override in staging was 3.5Gi, prod baseline was 4Gi — will add a note to the rollout doc.

jamie: thanks. if lee sees anything odd escalate to sam and i'll pause rollout. otherwise proceed to 50% at 21:55 UTC. will check back in 40m. :white_check_mark:

lee: watching now, will update if anything >0.5% error or p99 > 1.5s.

alex: 21:54 UTC update: moving to 50% now, quick canary run passing. logging the memory tweak in release notes.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: routing-service v2 scaled to 50% traffic at 2050079440 by alex.

jamie: great. closing active watch handoff to lee for 2h. if no issues by then we'll mark completed in the release doc. thanks everyone for quick responses. :tada:
